description: Field-level per-step visibility: one Permission per (field column, workflow step) pair.
notes: Permission is one of exactly three values: Editable, ReadOnly, Hidden — no fourth value observed across 132 UI-written Permission nodes on a live oracle.

Both back-refs (Column::Permission and Activity::Permission) are bidirectional and must both be maintained — a rebuild that deletes Permission nodes without sweeping these lists leaves PUT succeeding (200) but PUBLISH failing with a bare MetadataError.

Required is scoped by per-step visibility: a Required field that is Hidden at a given step is NOT enforced there, but a Required field that is Hidden at its OWN (only) visible step makes that step permanently unsubmittable.
A workflow rebuild (build_workflow-style, replacing every Activity) DELETES every Permission — re-run whatever wrote this matrix immediately after any workflow rebuild.
